title: علاش تبنى الجدار الدفاعي ف الصحراء المغربية؟
voice_text:
Read aloud in authentic Moroccan Darija (the Moroccan Arabic dialect spoken every day in Casablanca), with a natural Moroccan accent. Performance direction (do NOT read these directions aloud): open with a gripping, fast, punchy first sentence; sound genuinely curious on questions; slow down slightly on numbers and dates; a calm, serious tone when explaining the wall; build suspense before every sentence that starts with "ولكن"; end with a warm smile and a real question to the audience. Pronounce the words as the partial diacritics indicate, and do not read the diacritics themselves. Read the text below EXACTLY, word for word: do not add, improvise, explain or continue beyond it, and stop after the last sentence. Short pause between paragraphs:

2700 كِيلُومِتْر دْيَالْ الرمل والحجر!

وغادي نعرفو شكون بْنَاهْ، وعلاش؟

ف سنة 1980 كان الوضع ف الصحراء المغربية صْعِيبْ.

عناصر البوليساريو كِيهْجْمُو بسيارات سريعة، وكيختافو ف الصحراء.

والجيش المغربي ما قدرش يْلَحْقْهُمْ ف صحراء كبيرة بْحَالْ هاد.

فْجَاتْ فِكْرَة جديدة: جِدَارْ من الرمل والحجر!

بأمر من الملك الحسن الثاني رحمه الله، بْدَا البناء ف غُشْتْ 1980.

الجِدَارْ الأول حاوط العيون والسمارة وفوسفاط بوكراع.

500 كِيلُومِتْر دَازُو ف حوالي سنتين.

ولكن المُشْكِلْ ما تْحَلّْشْ، وْبْقَاوْ كِيبْنَاوْ جْدْرَانْ جْدَادْ!

ست جْدْرَانْ ف حوالي 7 سنين!

آخرها تكمل ف أبريل 1987، وطولو حوالي 550 كِيلُومِتْر.

ولكن شنو كاين داخل هاد الجِدَارْ؟

رمل وحجر، بعلو بين 2 و3 أمتار.

وراه خَنْدَقْ، وْحُقُولْ أَلْغَامْ.

وكل حوالي 5 كيلومترات، مركز مْرَاقْبَة.

ورادارات كَتْكْشَفْ حتى 60 كِيلُومِتْر وأكثر.

وف كل نقطة كبيرة، من 35 حتى 40 جندي.

وبعد الجِدَارْ، الهجمات السريعة ولات صعيبة.

وف 1991 وقع وقف إطلاق النار، تحت إشراف الأمم المتحدة.

2700 كِيلُومِتْر دْيَالْ الرمل. شْحَالْ كُنْتِي كَتْحْسَبْ طُولُو؟ كْتَبْ الرقم ف التعليقات!
image_prompts:
Create ONE single image: a sprite sheet with 8 separate objects arranged in a clean grid of 3 columns, portrait 1024x1536.
Order: left to right, then top to bottom, exactly as numbered below (the last row may be partly empty).
Background: one flat plain light-grey colour (#D9D9D9) everywhere. No gradient, no floor, no shadows, no texture.
Each object: fully visible, centered in its own cell, all about the same size, with wide empty space between objects. Objects must never touch or overlap.
No text, no numbers, no labels, no letters, no watermark, no grid lines, no borders.
Style for every object: glossy 3D render like Apple / Microsoft Fluent 3D emoji, soft studio lighting, smooth materials, vibrant natural colours, high detail, consistent style.
People: friendly 3D cartoon caricature (Pixar-like bust, head and shoulders), recognizable by their real signature features, respectful, not photorealistic.
1. A friendly soldier bust in a sand-coloured desert camouflage uniform and helmet, with a small red patch on the shoulder
2. A sand-coloured 4x4 desert pickup truck driving fast, with a dust cloud behind it
3. A yellow bulldozer pushing a heap of sand, on a small sandy mound
4. A cross-section block of a desert defensive embankment: a long sand-and-stone wall about two metres high, with a trench in front and a small stone bunker on top
5. A tall radar tower on a sandy hill, with a rotating radar dish on top and a small grey cabin at its base
6. A friendly United Nations peacekeeper bust wearing a light-blue helmet and a white vest
7. The flag of Morocco on a short golden pole: plain red field with a green five-pointed star outline in the center
8. A small sand-coloured stone watchtower outpost with a flat roof, a tiny red flag on top, and a sandbag wall around it
